verdict.rationale: cubic's own agent can commit: it generates fixes for review findings and pushes commits to the PR branch. It also maintains a rolling pull request for its exported wiki, and it generates PR descriptions. It does not act as a general git agent that stages a developer's changes, writes their commit messages, creates feature branches, or opens arbitrary PRs; the docs point developers to normal git commands for that. Missing for 10: agent-driven staging of the developer's changes, commit-message authoring, branch creation on request, opening PRs for user work, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent stage changes, write commit messages, create branches, and open pull requests
